subject.title: fix(qa): repair stale scenario source and documentation references

question: Should this maintainer-labeled QA integrity repair land once its current-base merge result and remaining required checks are confirmed?
rationale: The code path is a bounded cleanup, but the protected maintainer label requires explicit maintainer handling rather than automated closure or routing.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase or update the branch against current main, confirm the remaining checks on that merge result, then merge the QA catalog integrity repair.

options.title: Pause for QA owner review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want to narrow the catalog validation contract before making all scenario references a required invariant.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase or update the branch against current main, confirm the remaining checks on that merge result, then merge the QA catalog integrity repair.
